manifest.name: ErvisioTodo
manifest.author: Riccardo Reccia
manifest.description: Install, run and update ErvisioTodo on this machine with Docker: workspace settings, mail test, live logs and updates.

commands.name: has-docker
commands.description: Check whether Docker is installed (to find the ErvisioTodo containers, and before installing)

commands.name: user
commands.description: Read your user name (root uses Docker without an unlock prompt)

commands.name: groups
commands.description: Read your groups (members of docker use Docker without an unlock prompt)

commands.name: install-docker
argv:
# ervisio-inline
set -eu
p0=$1; shift; p1=$1; shift;
script=$(printf '%s' "$@" | base64 -d)
systemctl stop ervisio-todo-install.service 2>/dev/null || :; systemctl reset-failed ervisio-todo-install.service 2>/dev/null || :; umask 077; d=/opt/ervisio-todo/.plugin-config; mkdir -p "$d"; chmod 700 "$d"; printf '%s\n' "$script" > "$d/install-docker.sh"; exec systemd-run --unit=ervisio-todo-install --remain-after-exit --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin sh "$d/install-docker.sh" "$p0" "$p1"
commands.description: Install ErvisioTodo with Docker in /opt/ervisio-todo: download the release matching this plugin from GitHub and run deploy/ervisio-setup.sh in a systemd unit (ervisio-todo-install), which starts the Docker Compose stack

commands.name: install-state
commands.description: Read the state of the installation unit (ervisio-todo-install)

commands.name: install-log
commands.description: Read the output of the installation (the journal of ervisio-todo-install)

commands.name: update-docker
argv:
# ervisio-inline
set -eu
p0=$1; shift;
script=$(printf '%s' "$@" | base64 -d)
systemctl stop ervisio-todo-update.service 2>/dev/null || :; systemctl reset-failed ervisio-todo-update.service 2>/dev/null || :; umask 077; d=/opt/ervisio-todo/.plugin-config; mkdir -p "$d"; chmod 700 "$d"; printf '%s\n' "$script" > "$d/update-docker.sh"; exec systemd-run --unit=ervisio-todo-update --remain-after-exit --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin sh "$d/update-docker.sh" "$p0"
commands.description: Update the Docker installation in /opt/ervisio-todo to a release, in a systemd unit (ervisio-todo-update): back up .env next to itself, set ERVISIO_VERSION in .env, docker compose pull app, docker compose up -d

commands.name: update-state
commands.description: Read the state of the update unit (ervisio-todo-update)

commands.name: update-log
commands.description: Read the output of the update (the journal of ervisio-todo-update)

commands.name: configuration-read
argv:
# ervisio-inline
set -eu

script=$(printf '%s' "$@" | base64 -d)
exec sh -c "$script" configuration-read
commands.description: Recover existing Docker customization once and read persistent configuration with secrets redacted

commands.name: configuration-save
argv:
# ervisio-inline
set -eu
p0=$1; shift;
script=$(printf '%s' "$@" | base64 -d)
exec sh -c "$script" configuration-save "$p0"
commands.description: Validate and atomically save a private configuration request, restoring previous settings if Compose rejects it

commands.name: configuration-apply
argv:
# ervisio-inline
set -eu

script=$(printf '%s' "$@" | base64 -d)
exec sh -c "$script" configuration-apply
commands.description: Recreate the app from persisted configuration and wait for its health check
